name: @ground-truth/retreever-ratings
description: ReTreever's transparency scores and ranks: the scorers, their weights and their tests.
_why: Never published. A member of its parent's npm workspace, beside it on disk: the scorers import the parent's generated Prisma client and run lock through the `$parent` alias, so they run only from inside that workspace. `type: module` is load-bearing — the CLI entry points use top-level await.
